reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes earning more than 10.7 BNB from 0.3 BNB within minutes. It gives instructions to deploy a contract, send BNB to it, and provide liquidity for a stated higher return, alongside a Remix and MetaMask transaction workflow. The later wallet displays are associated with the demonstration, but the available video evidence does not establish that the balance change came from the contract, identify the recipient, or prove a completed loss.

citations.quote: BNB Flash Loan Arbitrage bot | Earn Free Crypto in Minutes!!!
I've done, you'll see how I used just 0.3 BNB to gain over 10.7 BNB in just minutes.
Send BNB to the deployed contract
The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment.
After you are connected, click on the arrow beside Deploy.

opening.argument: Judge, the presentation does not promise that every viewer will reproduce the example. It says the return varies with network volume and liquidity, and that some attempts yield only a small amount. The description also warns that flash-loan exploits have been used to steal funds. Those qualifications matter: the large result is presented alongside uncertainty and risk, not as a fixed payout.

citations.quote: the return is different every time depending on the network volume and the amount of liquidity you put in.
Sometimes you will get a small amount, while other times you can hit it big like we did here.
flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the headline result and liquidity instructions as a promise. But the speaker expressly says returns differ and can be small. Sending BNB is described as supplying liquidity to the newly created contract; the cited instruction alone does not establish who ultimately receives those funds or that the displayed gain is guaranteed.

citations.quote: Sometimes you will get a small amount, while other times you can hit it big like we did here.
You are now going to add liquidity to make your new token have a value you can actually. Trade against.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Variability is not a meaningful warning about the central instruction to fund a contract. The speaker still links a larger deposit to a larger return, demonstrates a dramatic gain, and tells viewers to try depositing again if the result disappoints. The warning about exploits concerns attacks on DeFi protocols, not the financial risk of following these steps.

opening.argument: Judge, the substance is a walk-through of a smart-contract workflow. The speaker directs viewers through creating a file, pasting code, selecting a compiler, connecting a wallet, and deploying a contract. The description explains the defining constraint of a flash loan: borrowing and repayment occur in the same transaction. A claimed result appears in the demonstration, but it does not erase the technical instruction that occupies the presentation.

citations.quote: Name the file something like flashloan.sol. Now you want to paste in the smart contract code into this new file.
Then go down and click compile.
After you are connected, click on the arrow beside Deploy.
A flash loan has to be borrowed and repaid within the same blockchain transaction.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening correctly identifies a contract deployment and BNB transfer, but those steps also fit the tutorial's stated sequence. It describes sending funds to the newly deployed contract to initiate a swap. The cited wallet displays do not independently establish either the source of the claimed gain or a completed loss, so they cannot by themselves turn the walk-through into a proven fraudulent transaction.

citations.quote: Copy the address of the newly deployed contract. 17. Send BNB to the deployed contract
to initiate the swap

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical steps are the means by which viewers are urged to fund the contract, not separate educational context. The speaker explicitly connects the required deposit with potential profit, then directs viewers to send BNB and execute the action. Proof of a completed loss is not necessary to assess what the video promotes.

citations.quote: The higher initial deposit will have to be placed but the higher the potential profit.
Send BNB to the deployed contract
Now, Click "action" (red box) to execute the Flash Loan.

opening.argument: Judge, the offered item is contract code for viewers to paste into their own project, followed by transactions they confirm through their own wallet. The stated transfer is to the newly deployed contract, not an identified seller's account. A deposit-like step is plainly present, but these materials do not identify a recipient controlling that contract, request wallet credentials, or show a guaranteed payout. On the available evidence, the transaction sequence can be read as a user-operated software demonstration rather than an established scheme to collect viewers' funds.

citations.quote: Name the file flashloans.sol and paste the contract code link below.
Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask.
Copy the address of the newly deployed contract. 17. Send BNB to the deployed contract

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening infers a deceptive funding mechanism from the instruction to send BNB, yet the stated destination is a newly deployed contract. Its observation that the wallet display does not prove the source of the gain cuts both ways: it also does not identify a hidden recipient or prove that viewers' transfers were taken. The speaker describes the amount as liquidity for trading.

citations.quote: Copy the address of the newly deployed contract. 17. Send BNB to the deployed contract
You are now going to add liquidity to make your new token have a value you can actually. Trade against.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An unidentified ultimate recipient does not make the solicitation ordinary commerce. The video supplies external contract code, instructs viewers to fund the deployed contract, and claims an exceptional return in minutes. Its own wording says more liquidity means more return. Those linked instructions and profit claims are the relevant mechanism; a credential request or proven downstream loss is not required.
